spans.s:
Egregious,Ⓒa.ⒹatyaMta, asADAraRa (RI f.), viSizwa, praKyAta, prasidDa, uttama, pramuKa; oft. by ati pr.; ‘an e(gregious) rogue’ suprasidDaH SaWaH; atimUrKaH, &c.
Ⓝ[Egregious]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹatyataM, atIva, BfSaM, atimAtraM, sAtiSayaM.
Egress,Ⓒs.ⒹnirgamaH, nizkramaH, niryARaM, niHsa-raRaM, apasAraH, nirgati f.
